source_caption_text:
Nicki Minaj completely snapped on her verse for YG’s “Big Bank” 😤🔥

Nicki Minaj’s verse on YG’s “Big Bank” is one of those features that instantly grabs your attention. She comes in after 2 Chainz and Big Sean and brings a completely different energy to the track.

Her verse is packed with punchlines, flexes and memorable wordplay, with her rapid delivery making every line stand out. The Slim Shady bar in particular became one of the biggest talking points around the song, adding even more attention to an already huge feature.

Nicki also brought that same energy to the music video, making her presence felt every time she appeared on screen. Years later, her verse is still one of the first things people remember about “Big Bank.”
